text.content:
Psycho Squad: the NCPD's cyberpsycho hunters, and its most respected unit.

Kind: Militarized police unit
Base: MAX-TAC HQ (#64), Wellsprings
Leadership: Commander Lorenzo "Contender" Lawrence
Purpose: Taking down cyberpsychos

MaxTac exists to stop cyberpsychos. Its AVs leave from the roof of MAX-TAC HQ in Wellsprings, and you'll hear them when they do.

MaxTac and the Purge

In 2047 MaxTac was an independent tactical agency outside the NCPD, commanded by Max Hammerman. Hammerman coordinated the off-the-books crew that ended Static Night, and gave Stop Sign and Contender a MaxTac squad to run alongside it for the forty-eight hours of the blackout. The second Purge Ordinance then handed MaxTac a fat city contract to suppress "net-terrorist and cyberpsychotic elements", which would have made it a second police force answerable to the Council. MaxTac backed the NCPD's sweeps through the Purge-Riot.

Hammerman turned the contract inside out: MaxTac rejoined the NCPD, the money went to the department instead of the Council's friends, and the NCPD became the city's one legal enforcement agency.

MaxTac in 2070

With C-SWAT, MaxTac is the stalwart of an honest institution, and its commander lets the Commissioner know it. Contender has hunted cyberpsychos for more than twenty years; he and Commissioner Ramos fight in public, and MaxTac usually wins. His troopers would walk into fire for him. His oldest trooper, Stop Sign, is the unit's best at talking a cyberpsycho down, unless the cyberpsycho wears colors.

Those who survive a MaxTac call often end up at NC Psychiatric Health in Rancho Coronado. Get on MaxTac's radar and you can become a target without ever losing your mind.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.28; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 02, 04, 10
